newsitem.title: EGYPT: Misr Exterior Bank H1 '96 net profits $10.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Misr Exterior Bank H1 '96 net profits $10.5 mln.

text.p: Egypt's private sector Misr Exterior Bank said on Saturday its net profits for the first six months of calendar 1996 were 35.78 million pounds ($10.52 million).
The joint-venture bank did not give any comparative six-month figures for 1995 but said net profits for the whole year were 46 million pounds.
Investments until June 30, 1996 were 761.13 million and investments in 1995 were 505.21 million.
Investors own 730,000 shares in Misr Exterior Bank which said its 1996 earnings per share were 49 pounds. It did not give a 1995 figure.
Shareholders' rights, including profits for the first six months of 1996, were 226.8 million pounds. In 1995, they stood at 191 million.
